# DecayFix

> AI-Powered Content Decay Detection and Search Traffic Recovery Engine for Google Search Console.

## Overview
DecayFix (developed by SprintLabs.ai) is a web-based analytics and content optimization tool that connects directly to Google Search Console via official read-only OAuth API. It automatically detects web pages and blog posts experiencing "content decay" — defined as a sustained 20% or greater decline in organic clicks or impressions compared to historical baselines.

DecayFix identifies whether traffic loss is caused by keyword ranking erosion, click-through-rate (CTR) collapse, or seasonal variation, and generates tailored AI-driven editorial refresh action plans to help content teams recover lost search rankings.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Zero-Friction Google Search Console Connection**: Connects in seconds using Google OAuth with read-only permissions (`webmasters.readonly`). No tracking scripts, plugins, or DNS modifications required.
- **Automated Historical Baseline Comparison**: Analyzes performance trends across up to 16 months of historical Search Console data to distinguish true content decay from short-term fluctuation.
- **20%+ Traffic Drop Detection**: Automatically pinpoints and ranks URLs suffering significant traffic erosion, sorting them by absolute organic clicks lost to prioritize highest-ROI content updates.
- **CTR-Collapse vs Ranking-Drop Diagnostics**: Separates pages losing impressions (ranking loss/relevance shifts) from pages maintaining impressions but losing clicks (CTR collapse/title tag degradation).
- **AI Refresh Action Playbooks**: Produces concise, 2-to-4 sentence editorial directives for each decaying URL, pinpointing missing keywords, outdated statistics, and structural improvements.
- **Continuous Monitoring**: Tracks ongoing URL performance, allowing content teams to verify whether content refreshes successfully restored search traffic.

## Pricing Structure
- **Free Diagnostic Preview ($0)**: Includes full Google Search Console connection, domain baseline analysis, and full diagnostics for the top 5 decaying URLs with AI refresh playbooks.
- **Pro Monthly Subscription (₹999 / month)**: Unlocks 100% of all decaying URLs across the connected domain, unlimited ongoing re-analyses, continuous traffic monitoring, and full AI refresh playbooks. Backed by a 7-day 100% money-back guarantee.

## Target Audiences
- **SaaS & Tech Companies**: Protect high-intent bottom-of-funnel comparison posts, feature guides, and product tutorials from competitor displacement.
- **eCommerce & D2C Brands**: Maintain organic rankings and revenue for high-converting buying guides, gift roundups, and product category articles.
- **SEO Agencies & Freelancers**: Eliminate hours of manual Google Search Console spreadsheet exports and deliver instant content refresh roadmaps to clients.
- **Publishers & Media Outlets**: Protect high-volume evergreen editorial archives and monitor editorial decay across thousands of articles.
